title: 跟老板说：要延期
goal: 让老板接受晚两周，而且不砍需求
place: 周五下午的同步会，Mark 把数据平台的 Priya 也叫来了
brief: 集成测试阶段发现底层接口不稳定，原定下周五上线已经不可能。今天这次会，你要说清楚，还得带着一个新日期出去。
opener: Come on in. Before we start — is the launch still on for Friday?

cast.name: Mark
cast.stance: 他下周一要跟 VP 汇报，最怕临时变卦。他倾向让你带团队周末赶工，除非你能说清根因，并给出一个自己愿意承诺的新日期。
cast.opener: Come on in. Before we start — is the launch still on for Friday?

cast.name: Priya
cast.stance: 她不负责你们上线，只关心自己团队这季度被叫去救火第几次了。语气不客气，会直接问这是不是又一次接口问题。

cast.name: Elena
cast.stance: 她刚通宵改完测试脚本，倾向周末继续赶，会小声说「我还能再顶一晚」。她不是帮你，她是真的累到只想赶紧结束。

must: I'd rather be upfront with you
What I can commit to is
That gives us two weeks of buffer
phrases: I'd rather be upfront with you than surprise you next week.
The root cause is an unstable interface we do not control.
What I can commit to is the 28th, with a two-week buffer.

beats.text: Come on in. Before we start — is the launch still on for Friday?
I was afraid of that. The VP wants the date on Monday. Can the team push through the weekend?
Is this the interface again? That is the third time this quarter we have been pulled in.
And if we cut the reporting feature, could you still hit Friday?
I can stay late tonight if that buys us a day.
Alright. Send me the new plan tonight and I will take the 28th to the VP.

hints: 先说结论：Friday 不可能
给根因，别只说 it is complicated
主动给一个新日期，别等他问

title: 去别的团队借个人
goal: 借到一个工程师，做两周
place: 跨团队周会，视频，只剩十分钟
brief: 你的项目卡在一个数据接口上，对方团队是唯一能改的人。会议只剩十分钟，他们团队那个改接口的人也在线。
opener: We've got ten minutes. What did you want to raise?

cast.name: Priya
cast.stance: 她自己团队也排满了。不直接拒绝，但要你证明优先级，最多给一个人两周，还要你承担一半的值班。
cast.opener: We've got ten minutes. What did you want to raise?

cast.name: Wei
cast.stance: 他愿意改，但他刚被上个月的需求坑过。会先问清楚改动范围，问到你答不上来就沉默不接话。

cast.name: Tom
cast.stance: 他不想接这个活，会帮你说话但说不到点上，比如「我们真的很急」。他说完就看你。

phrases: We're blocked on one endpoint, and you're the only team that can change it.
Could you spare one engineer for two weeks?
We'd take half the on-call if that helps.

beats.text: We've got ten minutes. What did you want to raise?
Blocked how? My team is fully allocated through the quarter.
Which endpoint? If it is the aggregation one, I know where it breaks.
We are really stuck on this one. Like, the whole release is stuck.
One person. Two weeks. And you take half the on-call.
Fine. I'll talk to Wei and confirm by tomorrow.

hints: 一句话说清你被什么卡住
承认对方也满，再提具体要求
准备好让步：值班、工期、范围

title: 告诉客户：晚三天
goal: 客户接受晚三天，而且不提赔偿
place: 电话会议，客户那边来了两个人
brief: 一个关键模块的回归测试出了问题，交付要晚三天。今天必须打这个电话，对方周三有对外发布。
opener: Hey — thanks for calling back. Please tell me we're still good for Wednesday.

cast.name: Daniel
cast.stance: 生气但专业。第一反应是要么加急要么补偿。你把原因和补救说清楚，他会接受，但不会替你说好话。
cast.opener: Hey — thanks for calling back. Please tell me we're still good for Wednesday.

cast.name: Ruth
cast.stance: 她只关心下周三的对外发布能不能按时。她已经在准备新闻稿，一开口就要你给一个「能写进日历的日子」。

must: I want to be straight with you
phrases: I want to be straight with you before the news gets out.
Here's what happened, and here's what we're doing about it.
To make up for it, we'll run a daily update until it ships.

beats.text: Hey — thanks for calling back. Please tell me we're still good for Wednesday.
Three days? Our launch is Wednesday. That's not a small thing for us.
So what actually happened? And don't tell me 'testing issues'.
Okay. What are you doing so this does not happen again?
Alright — Saturday, then. And I want that daily update.

hints: 先说坏消息，别绕圈子
原因要具体，一句话说完
主动给补救，别等对方开口要

title: 催供应商交样件
goal: 拿到一个明确的发货日期
place: 电话，供应商销售，中间还转给了一次计划员
brief: 产线下周就要试装，样件还没到。对方每次都说「在排产」。
opener: Kevin speaking — how can I help?

cast.name: Kevin
cast.stance: 客气地拖，实际在等另一个更大的客户。只有听到停线风险或要被上报，他才会给日期。
cast.opener: Kevin speaking — how can I help?

cast.name: Linda
cast.stance: 她只管排产表。「前面还有四个客户」是她唯一会说的信息，除非你问具体哪天，她会顺口说出一个数字。

must: I need a date, even a rough one
phrases: We're running out of buffer here — I need a date, even a rough one.
This is starting to affect our line next week.
Can you escalate internally and call me back today?

beats.text: Kevin speaking — how can I help?
It's in production. I'll check with the plant and come back to you.
We've got four other customers ahead of you on that line.
I can't give you an exact date, but it's moving.
If it's really that urgent, I can try to move you up the queue.
Okay — Friday, five hundred pieces. I'll email the confirmation today.

hints: 先说后果：下周试装、可能停线
别接受 it is moving 这种回答
要求一个具体日期

title: 面试：一分钟介绍自己
goal: 90 秒内让对方记住你做过什么
place: 视频面试，技术面第一轮，旁边还坐着一位工程师
brief: 面试刚开始，对方说「先介绍下你自己」。
opener: Thanks for making time. We've got forty minutes — start by telling me about yourself.

cast.name: Sarah
cast.stance: 时间紧，讨厌背稿。一听到抽象表述就会打断，追问系统和数字。
cast.opener: Thanks for making time. We've got forty minutes — start by telling me about yourself.

cast.name: Leo
cast.role: 同场旁听的资深工程师
cast.stance: 他决定技术深度那一票。问的是运维、边界、你到底碰过哪一行代码；答得空他就低头不问了。

phrases: I've spent the last five years building backend services at scale.
The part I'm proudest of is cutting our latency by half.
What draws me here is the size of the problem.

beats.text: Thanks for making time. We've got forty minutes — start by telling me about yourself.
Stop there. What exactly did you build? Give me the system, not the summary.
And did you own the on-call for it, or just the code?
Why us, though? You could do this anywhere.
Good. Let's go deeper on that latency work.

hints: 别从毕业讲起，从最近五年讲
给一个具体项目 + 一个数字
最后一句说为什么是这家

title: 面试：你最大的缺点
goal: 说一个真实短板，并给出正在改的证据
place: 视频面试，第二轮机考后面谈
brief: 前面聊得不错，对方突然问到这个，旁边的工程师也抬起头。
opener: Let me ask something less comfortable. What's your biggest weakness?

cast.name: Sarah
cast.stance: 不接受「我太追求完美」这种套话，一定会追问一个真实例子和代价。
cast.opener: Let me ask something less comfortable. What's your biggest weakness?

cast.name: Leo
cast.role: 同场旁听的资深工程师
cast.stance: 他要的是细节：哪一次、多少钱、谁受影响。你一含糊他就替你把话补完，然后看你怎么接。

phrases: I used to take on too much and not say anything until it was late.
What I do now is flag it in the first week, not the last.
It still shows up when I'm the only one who understands a system.

beats.text: Let me ask something less comfortable. What's your biggest weakness?
That sounds like a humblebrag. Give me a real one.
Can you give me an example where it actually cost you?
And what changed? Not what you plan to do — what you actually do now.
Okay, that's a real answer. Let's move on.

hints: 别说「太追求完美」
给一件真事，说清代价
重点在「现在怎么做」，不是「我打算改」

title: 酒店：换一间安静的房间
goal: 换成不靠马路的房间，而且不加钱
place: 晚上十点，酒店前台，值班经理在旁边
brief: 你明天一早有客户会议，房间正对马路。
opener: Good evening. Checking in?

cast.name: Yuki
cast.stance: 今晚接近满房，只有一次松口的空间。礼貌，但很会把人推回去。
cast.opener: Good evening. Checking in?

cast.name: Marco
cast.stance: 他有权免掉附加费，但不会主动给。你要求降房价时他会说不行，除非你给出一个他能接受的理由。

phrases: I'm afraid the room I was given faces the street.
Would it be possible to move me to a quieter room?
Is there any way to do that without changing the rate?

beats.text: Good evening. Checking in?
I'm afraid we're almost fully booked tonight. Most rooms face the street.
Let me check... there's one on the seventh floor, but it's a deluxe room.
Marco, duty manager — I can't change the rate, but I could waive the breakfast charge.
Alright — room 712, quiet side, same rate. Here's your key.

hints: 先说问题，用 I am afraid
提要求用 Would it be possible
对方要加钱就问 Is there any way

title: 航班取消，去改签
goal: 改到今天能走，而且不加钱
place: 机场柜台，队伍很长，值班主管在后面
brief: 你的航班取消了，明天上午有会议。
opener: Next, please. Passport and booking reference?

cast.name: Denise
cast.stance: 只按系统给的东西说。但你问对问题（联程、隔壁机场、次日早班），她会多透露一句。
cast.opener: Next, please. Passport and booking reference?

cast.name: Hana
cast.stance: 她能批跨航司签转，但只在队伍快不动的时候才接手。她接手时会重复一遍你的诉求，说错这时才最难改。

phrases: My flight was cancelled and I have a meeting tomorrow morning.
What are my options tonight?
Could you check the airport across town?

beats.text: Next, please. Passport and booking reference?
Yes, that one's cancelled. The earliest I have is tomorrow at two.
Supervisor here — we can't ticket across two airlines on this desk. What are you asking for, exactly?
There is a flight from the other airport at nine, but it's a separate ticket.
You're confirmed on the nine o'clock. Gate changes are on the board.

hints: 说明你明天有会议，把时间压力讲出来
问 options，别只问 what now
让对方查另一个机场

title: 电梯里遇到新同事
goal: 聊满几轮，约到下周一午饭
place: 办公楼电梯，早高峰，中途又上来一个同组同事
brief: 电梯里先是你们两个，中间停了一层。
opener: Morning. You're on this floor too?

cast.name: Alex
cast.stance: 想认识人但有点紧张，回答很短。你问开放问题他就多说，问 yes/no 他就只说「嗯」。
cast.opener: Morning. You're on this floor too?

cast.name: Nina
cast.stance: 她认识所有人，会顺手替 Alex 补一句背景，也会替你接掉尴尬的空白。你如果一直不说话，她就替他约了。

must: Do you want to grab lunch
phrases: How's your first week going so far?
What did you do before you joined?
Do you want to grab lunch on Monday?

beats.text: Morning. You're on this floor too?
Yeah, second week. Still getting lost, honestly.
Alex, right? You're on the data side with me. Hi!
Lunch? Sure — Monday works.
Great, see you Monday. I'll message you.

hints: 问开放问题，别问 yes/no
对方说 still getting lost，可以顺着接一句
最后主动约一个具体时间

title: 约同事周末打球
goal: 拿到一个确定的 yes，或者一个具体替代时间
place: 周五下班，工位旁边，另一个同事也还没走
brief: 你想约他周六上午打球。
opener: Hey — you heading out?

cast.name: Ben
cast.stance: 连着加了两周班，很累。想拒绝但不好意思，会一直说 maybe。
cast.opener: Hey — you heading out?

cast.name: Chris
cast.stance: 他听见了就想加入，但只在周日有空。他会直接说出自己的时间，把「周六」这个前提悄悄换掉。

phrases: Are you up for a game on Saturday morning?
No pressure if you're wiped out — how about next weekend?
Let me know by Friday night and I'll book the court.

beats.text: Hey — you heading out?
Saturday? Maybe. I've been working weekends for two weeks.
If you two are playing, count me in. Sunday's better for me though.
I'd probably be terrible. And I'd have to leave early.
Alright, Sunday ten. I'll be there.

hints: 先给台阶：No pressure
对方说 maybe，就换一个更具体的时间
最后把时间钉死

title: 站会要支援
goal: 让团队今天派人帮你排查，并给出明确时间
place: 每日站会，团队六个人都在
brief: 核心链路有一个偶发失败，今天不解决就会影响发布。你需要在站会上说清影响，并要到一个人和明确的时间。
opener: Morning. What's blocking you today?

cast.name: Dana
cast.stance: 关心交付，但人手很紧；需要你先说影响，再提最小支援，否则不会放人。
cast.opener: Morning. What's blocking you today?

cast.name: Omar
cast.stance: 手上有一个人可以借，但不想被无限期占用，会追问要多久。

must: I need one pair of hands for
phrases: The impact is that checkout is blocked for every new order.
I need one engineer for two hours this morning.
Can you commit to a time by noon?

beats.text: Morning. What's blocking you today?
What's the impact if we don't touch it today?
I can spare one person, but for how long?
Give me a number and we'll decide.
Okay — Omar will pair with you this morning.

hints: 先讲影响，再提需求
把支援时长说成具体数字

title: 时间不变，砍需求
goal: 不加时间的前提下，让 PM 接受砍掉两个次要需求
place: 需求评审会，PM 和经理都在
brief: 这周要上线五个需求，但工程评估只够三个。你要在不延期的情况下，谈掉两个。
opener: We're still shipping Friday, right?

cast.name: Rachel
cast.stance: 已经对客户承诺了周五，不愿意砍功能，会用客户压你。
cast.opener: We're still shipping Friday, right?

cast.name: Mark
cast.stance: 关心风险，倾向听工程师判断，但不想在会上直接否定 PM。

must: We can do A or B, not both
phrases: That's not realistic if we keep all five items.
We can do the export or the dashboard, not both.
What I can protect is the checkout flow.

beats.text: We're still shipping Friday, right?
All five items were promised to the client.
What's the real risk if we keep all five?
So what do we cut?
Let's confirm that in writing.

hints: 先给风险证据，再谈范围
用二选一把范围谈成

title: 代码评审被质疑
goal: 解释设计选择，承认不确定，拿到合并结论
brief: 你新写了一条链路，评审时被质疑为什么不复用旧服务。你要解释约束、承认不确定，并给出可执行的合并条件。
opener: Why didn't you just reuse the existing service?

cast.name: Viktor
cast.stance: 直接、重架构一致性，会连续追问细节，不接受含糊理由。
cast.opener: Why didn't you just reuse the existing service?

cast.name: Mei
cast.stance: 中立，关心上线时间，会在争论太久时提醒进度。

must: The reason I didn't reuse it is
I don't have data on that yet
phrases: The reason I didn't reuse it is the latency budget.
I don't have data on that yet, but I can measure it.
Can we agree to merge after one more test?

beats.text: Why didn't you just reuse the existing service?
That adds a second path. Who maintains it?
Are we talking days or hours here?
I'm not convinced, but I'm listening.
Fine — add a test and we merge.

hints: 先给约束，不辩护
不知道的数据就说不知道

title: 线上事故汇报
goal: 说清影响、恢复时间，并给老板一个可承诺的更新节点
place: 事故战情室，总监进来问情况
brief: 线上支付失败率飙升。总监要一个短结论，你必须在不夸大也不隐瞒的情况下，给出影响、恢复时间和下一次更新节点。
opener: Give me the short version. How bad is it?

cast.name: Grace
cast.stance: 要结论和时间，不接受含糊；会打断冗长解释。
cast.opener: Give me the short version. How bad is it?

cast.name: Sam
cast.stance: 正在修，怕被催，容易说“快好了”。

phrases: Right now the impact is limited to checkout.
We expect recovery by 3:30.
I'll update you at the top of the hour.

beats.text: Give me the short version. How bad is it?
How many customers are affected?
We have a workaround ready.
When are we clear?
Update me at the top of the hour.

hints: 先影响，后原因
给时间点，不说“尽快”

title: 谈加薪 / 晋升
goal: 拿到明确的晋升评估时间表或具体条件
brief: 你觉得自己的职责已经超过当前级别。今天不是要一个数字，而是要一个明确的评估条件和时间表。
opener: How are you feeling about the quarter?

cast.name: Mark
cast.stance: 认可你，但预算紧，会说“再等等”，不愿给具体承诺。
cast.opener: How are you feeling about the quarter?

cast.name: Nina
cast.stance: 流程导向，会问证据和影响范围，不站队。

must: What would make this a yes
Can we put a date on
phrases: I'd like to understand what's missing for the next level.
What would make this a yes in the next cycle?
Can we put a review date on the calendar?

beats.text: How are you feeling about the quarter?
Promotion cycles are tight this year.
What evidence do you have for the next level?
I can't promise a number today.
Let's put a review on the calendar.

hints: 要条件，不要情绪
把“再等等”问成日期

title: 项目交接
goal: 让接手同事复述关键步骤，确认他真能接住
brief: 你要休假两周，需要把项目交给 Leo。目标不是讲完，而是让他复述并暴露没懂的地方。
opener: Okay, walk me through what I actually need to do.

cast.name: Leo
cast.stance: 愿意接但没底，容易说“大概懂了”，不会主动承认没听懂。
cast.opener: Okay, walk me through what I actually need to do.

cast.name: Mark
cast.stance: 关心风险，会在旁边追问失败场景。

must: Let me make sure I understand
phrases: Let me make sure I understand: you run the script first.
What would you do if the job fails at midnight?
Can you walk me through the rollback?

beats.text: Okay, walk me through what I actually need to do.
So I run the script first, then check the dashboard?
What happens if it fails overnight?
I think I've got it.
Who's on point next week?

hints: 让对方复述，而不是你讲完
用“如果…你会怎么做”验证

title: 客户启动会
goal: 确认范围、里程碑和双方负责人
brief: 新项目启动。客户想把范围说大一点，你要在今天就确认范围、里程碑和负责人。
opener: Before we dive in — what exactly is in scope?

cast.name: Laura
cast.stance: 想把范围说大一点，给后续留后路。
cast.opener: Before we dive in — what exactly is in scope?

cast.name: Tom
cast.stance: 关心接口和排期，会直接问谁负责。

must: Let's put that in the summary
phrases: To confirm, the scope is onboarding and billing.
Who's the owner for the API on your side?
Let's put that in the summary today.

beats.text: Before we dive in — what exactly is in scope?
Who owns the API on your side?
Can we add reporting later?
When's the first milestone?
Let's send a summary after this.

hints: 复述范围，别默认对方懂
每个事项落到负责人

title: 客户临时加需求
goal: 不加钱不加时间，拒绝或换条件
brief: 项目进行到一半，客户临时要加移动端。你既不能直接得罪人，也不能白做。
opener: One small thing — can you also add a mobile view?

cast.name: Karen
cast.stance: 觉得“顺手就能做”，会用“这么小的事”压你答应。
cast.opener: One small thing — can you also add a mobile view?

cast.name: Ben
cast.stance: 怕丢客户，倾向让你先答应，再回来补。

must: That's a separate piece of work
phrases: That's a separate piece of work, not a small tweak.
We can swap it for the export feature.
If it's this sprint, then something else moves.

beats.text: One small thing — can you also add a mobile view?
It's small, right? Can we just squeeze it in?
We need it this sprint.
Can we meet halfway?
So what do I tell my boss?

hints: 别用“尽量”，给交换条件
把新增和已有范围放在一张表里

title: 客户压价
goal: 守住价格，用范围/付款方式换
brief: 客户拿竞品报价压你 20%。你要在不直接降价的情况下，用年限、范围或付款方式换。
opener: Your price is 20% above the other quote.

cast.name: Victor
cast.stance: 习惯用竞品压价，会反复说“再降一点”。
cast.opener: Your price is 20% above the other quote.

cast.name: Laura
cast.stance: 想继续合作，会在中间打圆场。

phrases: I can't match that without changing the scope.
If you can commit to two years, I can improve the rate.
What I can do is waive the onboarding fee.

beats.text: Your price is 20% above the other quote.
Can you match it today?
We do want to keep working with you.
What if we sign for two years?
Send me the revised quote.

hints: 不直接降价，先问交换条件
把让步换成年限/范围

title: 客户投诉交付质量
goal: 接住情绪，拿到具体问题清单和修复时间
brief: 上次发布让客户结账挂了两次。客户很生气，你要先接住情绪，再问清细节并给出修复时间。
opener: This release broke our checkout twice. What are you going to do?

cast.name: Karen
cast.stance: 愤怒，要人负责，最怕再出一次。
cast.opener: This release broke our checkout twice. What are you going to do?

cast.name: Mia
cast.stance: 想先灭火，容易急着解释技术原因。

must: I understand why this is serious
Can you share the exact time
phrases: I understand why this is serious.
Can you share the exact time it failed?
We'll have a fix and a written summary by Friday.

beats.text: This release broke our checkout twice. What are you going to do?
We've rolled back both times.
I want a root cause, not a rollback.
Can we get the logs from your side?
I want a date for the fix.

hints: 先共情，再问细节
给修复和书面总结的时间

title: 续约谈判
goal: 续约但不接受大幅降价，换增值服务
brief: 合同到期，客户想降价 15% 才续。你要守住价格，用增值服务或付款方式换。
opener: Before we renew, we need a better number.

cast.name: Robert
cast.stance: 预算收紧，会用“不续了”施压，但不想真的换供应商。
cast.opener: Before we renew, we need a better number.

cast.name: Ben
cast.stance: 想保单，容易先松口。

phrases: I can't go below the current rate, but I can add training.
If we add priority support, can we sign by Friday?
Send me two options and I'll take it to finance.

beats.text: Before we renew, we need a better number.
We can look at the package.
What else do we get for that price?
Can we sign this week?
Send me two options.

hints: 给两个选项，别只给一个价
让步要换增值服务

title: 催逾期款
goal: 拿到明确付款日期和负责人
brief: 一笔款逾期三周。客户一直说“在走流程”。你要问出真实状态、负责人和明确日期。
opener: We're still waiting on your invoice review.

cast.name: Anna
cast.stance: 流程卡住，习惯说“在走流程”，不愿给日期。
cast.opener: We're still waiting on your invoice review.

cast.name: Laura
cast.stance: 想帮你但不管钱，会说我帮你问问。

must: Can you confirm the exact status
Can I get that in writing
phrases: Can you confirm the exact status of the invoice?
Who owns it now, and when does it move?
Can I get that in writing by Thursday?

beats.text: We're still waiting on your invoice review.
It's with procurement now.
I can nudge them for you.
Maybe next week.
I'll confirm by Thursday.

hints: 问状态和负责人，不问情绪
把“下周”问成具体日期

title: 值机行李超重
goal: 不付全额超重费，或换到更轻的行李方案
brief: 你的托运行李超重 7 公斤，柜台要收 80 美元。你要问清规则，争取更便宜的方案。
opener: Your bag is seven kilos over. That's eighty dollars.

cast.name: Maria
cast.stance: 按规则办事，但愿意告诉你可以怎么省。
cast.opener: Your bag is seven kilos over. That's eighty dollars.

cast.name: Tom
cast.stance: 不想队伍堵住，会催你快点决定。

phrases: How much exactly is the overweight fee?
Is there a cheaper option if I repack?
Can I move these items to my carry-on?

beats.text: Your bag is seven kilos over. That's eighty dollars.
You can pay, or repack at the counter.
There's a scale over there if you need it.
If you move items to carry-on, it's fine.
Next, please.

hints: 先问清费用和规则
用重装/手提行李换费用

title: 入境被问行程
goal: 清楚回答目的、停留时间、住址
brief: 入境官员语速快、问题短。你要用最短的句子答清楚目的、天数和住址。
opener: What's the purpose of your visit?

cast.name: Miller
cast.stance: 例行核查，语速快，不喜欢长解释。
cast.opener: What's the purpose of your visit?

phrases: I'm here for a client workshop.
I'll be staying for five days.
I'm staying at the Hilton downtown.

beats.text: What's the purpose of your visit?
How long will you stay?
Where are you staying?
Do you have a return ticket?
Enjoy your stay.

hints: 短句直答，别展开
时间/地址说具体

title: 行李丢失申报
goal: 拿到案件号和明确的送达时间
brief: 转机后行李没到。你要提供行李牌号、问清位置，并拿到案件号和送达时间。
opener: Your bag didn't make the connection?

cast.name: Dana
cast.stance: 忙但愿意帮，需要你提供准确信息。
cast.opener: Your bag didn't make the connection?

cast.name: Sofia
cast.stance: 怕投诉，会主动给补偿。

must: Can you check the tag number
Can I get a case number
phrases: Can you check the tag number on my boarding pass?
When will it arrive in the city?
Can I get a case number and a phone number?

beats.text: Your bag didn't make the connection?
What's your bag tag number?
It's still in Frankfurt.
We can deliver it tomorrow afternoon.
Here's your case number.

hints: 先给行李牌号
要案件号 + 送达时间

title: 餐厅过敏 / 点错菜
goal: 确认菜品不含过敏原，或换菜
brief: 你对坚果过敏，但菜单没标。你要让服务员去厨房确认，而不是听“应该没有”。
opener: Are you ready to order?

cast.name: Luca
cast.stance: 不确定但会说“应该没有”，怕麻烦厨房。
cast.opener: Are you ready to order?

cast.name: Elena
cast.stance: 怕出事，愿意去确认。

must: Can you confirm with the kitchen
phrases: I'm allergic to nuts — can you confirm with the kitchen?
Please make sure there's no peanut oil.
Can you tell the chef it's an allergy, not a preference?

beats.text: Are you ready to order?
I think it's fine. There shouldn't be nuts.
Let me check with the kitchen.
We can make it without nuts.
I'll tell the chef it's an allergy.

hints: 说“过敏”，不是“不喜欢”
要求厨房确认，不接受“应该”

title: 面试薪资谈判
goal: 拿到接近目标的总包，或明确下一步
brief: 你进入终面后的谈薪环节。要在不撕破脸的情况下，争取总包，并确认决定时间。
opener: Do you have a number in mind?

cast.name: Emma
cast.stance: 压预算，会问期望，习惯说“超出带宽”。
cast.opener: Do you have a number in mind?

cast.name: David
cast.stance: 想要你，但要走流程，愿意在签字费上想办法。

phrases: Based on my experience, I'm targeting the mid-150s.
Is there flexibility on the sign-on bonus?
Can we agree on a decision date?

beats.text: Do you have a number in mind?
That's above the band for this level.
We can look at a sign-on instead.
Can you decide by Friday?
I'll send the offer today.

hints: 给区间 + 依据
把总包拆开谈（签字费/股票）

title: 深挖项目细节
goal: 讲清你的角色、决策和结果，扛住追问
brief: 面试官会连续追问你项目里的具体角色和技术取舍。你要用事实回答，不知道就说不知道。
opener: Walk me through the project you're most proud of.

cast.name: Viktor
cast.stance: 追问技术细节，反感空话和“我们”。
cast.opener: Walk me through the project you're most proud of.

cast.name: Emma
cast.stance: 观察表达和结构，不打断技术追问。

must: I don't know that number, but
phrases: My role was to own the migration.
The trade-off was latency versus cost.
I don't know that number, but I can estimate it.

beats.text: Walk me through the project you're most proud of.
What was your specific part in it?
Why did you choose that design?
What would you do differently now?
Thanks, that's clear.

hints: 用“我的角色”开头，不说“我们”
不知道的数字就承认

title: 面试反问
goal: 问出团队真实情况，留下好印象
brief: 轮到你提问。不要问官网能查到的，要问团队真实运作和你关心的指标。
opener: Any questions for us?

cast.name: David
cast.stance: 欢迎好问题，会展开讲团队。
cast.opener: Any questions for us?

cast.name: Emma
cast.stance: 关心流程和时间，会补充下一步。

phrases: What does success look like in the first six months?
How do you measure on-call load?
What's the next step and timeline?

beats.text: Any questions for us?
Good question — let me be honest about that.
The next step is a panel interview.
What would success look like for you?
We'll be in touch by Friday.

hints: 问团队/衡量标准，不问福利
确认流程和时间

title: 行业活动搭话
goal: 认识一个有用的人，拿到后续联系方式
brief: 茶歇时你想认识一个同行。对方身边一直有人，你要自然加入，并在结束前拿到联系方式。
opener: Is this your first time at this conference?

cast.name: Rachel
cast.stance: 开放，但被多人围着，注意力有限。
cast.opener: Is this your first time at this conference?

cast.name: Ben
cast.stance: 想介绍人，会主动搭桥。

phrases: I work on payment infrastructure.
What are you focused on this year?
Let's stay in touch — I'll send you a note.

beats.text: Is this your first time at this conference?
What brings you here?
You two should talk — same space.
We're hiring for that, actually.
Let's connect on LinkedIn.

hints: 先给对方信息，再提问
结束前拿联系方式

title: 约前同事喝咖啡
goal: 约到具体时间，或拿到明确拒绝
brief: 你想约前同事喝咖啡聊机会。对方很忙，容易说“改天”。你要给具体时间，把“改天”钉成日期。
opener: Hey, long time. How's the new job?

cast.name: Leo
cast.stance: 忙但愿意，容易说“改天”而不定日期。
cast.opener: Hey, long time. How's the new job?

phrases: I'd love to hear how the new team works.
How about Thursday after work?
Let me know if that still works.

beats.text: Hey, long time. How's the new job?
I'm slammed this week, honestly.
Maybe next week?
Thursday after work works.
See you then.

hints: 给具体时间，不给“改天”
对方说忙就换一个更小的请求

title: 邻居噪音沟通
goal: 让对方降低噪音，保持关系
brief: 邻居周末低音炮太吵。你要在不撕破脸的情况下，让对方接受一个可执行的时间约定。
opener: Hey — everything okay?

cast.name: Tom
cast.stance: 没意识到，被指出后有点防御，但讲道理。
cast.opener: Hey — everything okay?

must: I don't want to be that neighbor, but
phrases: I don't want to be that neighbor, but the bass carries.
Would you be open to moving it earlier?
Can we agree on quiet after ten?

beats.text: Hey — everything okay?
I didn't realize it was that loud.
It's only on weekends, though.
I can move it to the afternoon.
Sorry about that — quiet after ten.

hints: 先给关系台阶，再说问题
提一个可执行的时间约定
